name: Nutcracker
lore: A carved sentry who keeps the winter lights burning along the roads to Crossroads.

technique.name: Banner Drill
technique.description: Plant a parade banner for 4 seconds. Nearby allies gain 18% damage reduction and 15% movement speed.

attack.name: Banner Drill
attack.description: Plant a parade banner for 4 seconds. Nearby allies gain 18% damage reduction and 15% movement speed.
attack.ui_brief: Plant a parade banner for 4 seconds. Nearby allies gain 18% damage reduction and 15% movement speed.

final_technique.name: Clockwork Volley
final_technique.description: Place a sentry facing your aim. It fires three volleys of three toy bolts down that lane.

attack.name: Clockwork Volley
attack.description: Place a sentry facing your aim. It fires three volleys of three toy bolts down that lane.
attack.ui_brief: Place a sentry facing your aim. It fires three volleys of three toy bolts down that lane.

primary.name: Spear Jab
primary.description: Quick, narrow thrust with a long spear. Can hit enemies lined up in the thrust.
primary.ui_brief: Quick, narrow thrust with a long spear. Can hit enemies lined up in the thrust.

secondary.name: Stand Fast
secondary.description: Brace for 4.5 seconds. Take 25% less damage; Spear Jab gains 40% reach and 25% damage. Walk and turn more slowly. Press Secondary again to cancel.
secondary.ui_brief: Brace for 4.5 seconds. Take 25% less damage; Spear Jab gains 40% reach and 25% damage. Walk and turn more slowly. Press Secondary again to cancel.

special.name: Tannenbaum
special.description: Plant a tree for 7.2 seconds. Its flickering cones heal allies for 5 HP per pulse. Rolling ornaments explode when they hit an enemy, dealing 14 area damage.
special.ui_brief: Plant a tree for 7.2 seconds. Its flickering cones heal allies for 5 HP per pulse. Rolling ornaments explode when they hit an enemy, dealing 14 area damage.
